guard: The real Manager sweep preserves ACL and member disappearance evidence from native teardown
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/manager build && pnpm smoke:freeslot-barrier:live

mutations.name: discard ACL disappearance in Manager sweep aggregation
mutations.expectRed: RECONCILE RACE: Manager aggregates KV disappearances without claiming prior absence or own deletion
mutations.cell: RECONCILE RACE: Manager aggregates KV disappearances without claiming prior absence or own deletion
mutations.afterRestore: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/manager build && pnpm smoke:freeslot-barrier:live

mutations.name: discard member disappearance in Manager sweep aggregation
mutations.expectRed: RECONCILE RACE: Manager aggregates KV disappearances without claiming prior absence or own deletion
mutations.cell: RECONCILE RACE: Manager aggregates KV disappearances without claiming prior absence or own deletion
mutations.afterRestore: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/manager build && pnpm smoke:freeslot-barrier:live
